The assertion expects `[3, 4]` (the input itself) in the output, so the center must be included. The team note's "exclude the center" option would fail this test, so I'm keeping the 3×3 version.

```python
def get_coordinates(coord):
    x, y = coord
    return [[i, j] for i in range(x - 1, x + 2) for j in range(y - 1, y + 2)]
```
